SELECT count(*) lines, count(distinct sales_line_id) ids, count(distinct (receipt_id, line_no)) rl, min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at), sum(net_amount) FROM p

SELECT (SELECT count(*)-count(distinct store_key) FROM dim_store) dup_store_key,
 (SELECT count(*)-count(distinct product_key) FROM dim_product) dup_prod_key,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id)) orphan_returns,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id WHERE r.refund_net>f.net_amount+0.005) over_refund,

calls.statement:
SELECT s.store_id, s.format, count(*) n, min(r.return_date-f.sale_date) mn, max(r.return_date-f.sale_date) mx, min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date)
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE r.return_date>f.sale_date+30 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT r.return_date-f.sale_date AS lag, count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 15

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, cs.format, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT s.format, SUM(s.net_amount) AS sold_net, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0) AS returned_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0) / SUM(s.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct,
       count(*) lines, count(r.sales_line_id) returned_lines
FROM sold s LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.sales_line_id = s.sales_line_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'all' k, count(*) n, SUM(net_amount) v FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'
UNION ALL SELECT 'joined', count(*), SUM(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'
UNION ALL SELECT 'store999_or_ZZ', count(*), SUM(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND (s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test')
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_status_'||o.status, count(*), SUM(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' GROUP BY o.status
